raw.query: WITH d AS (SELECT run_id, window_name, window_requests, lead_s FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE is_current = true AND experiment = 'a2' AND policy = 'reactive'), span_windows AS (SELECT DISTINCT window_name, window_requests FROM d), burst3 AS (SELECT d.lead_s, d.window_requests, i.is_violation, i.achieved_p99_ms, i.bound_ms FROM d JOIN provenance.v_infraction AS i ON i.run_id = d.run_id AND i.is_current = true WHERE d.window_name = 'burst3' AND i.sla_metric = 'encoder_delay' AND i.bound_stat = 'p99') SELECT ARRAY_AGG(lead_s ORDER BY lead_s) AS leads_s, BOOL_AND(is_violation) AS fails_every_lead, ARRAY_AGG(achieved_p99_ms ORDER BY lead_s) AS achieved_p99_ms, MAX(bound_ms) AS bound_ms, MAX(window_requests) AS burst3_requests, (SELECT SUM(window_requests) FROM span_windows) AS span_requests, 100.0 * MAX(window_requests) / (SELECT SUM(window_requests) FROM span_windows) AS burst3_percent_of_span FROM burst3
